verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents recurring, unattended sync automation: each connection can use a Scheduled or Cron schedule type, and Airbyte runs syncs on the user-defined cron expression. Cloud can also chain dbt transformations to run immediately after syncs and send webhook or email notifications, so pipelines run in the background without manual triggering. missing for 10: evidence of AI- or agent-driven setup of these background automations, and independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled-run reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: The three options for `Schedule Type` are: Scheduled, Cron, Manual
Runs the syncs based on the user-defined cron expression
you can also use CRON scheduling to set a specific time of day or month.
you can create and run dbt transformations immediately following syncs in Airbyte Cloud.
Airbyte can send notifications to an email address, webhook, or both.
